findings.description: The task specification explicitly required auditing 'every raw SQL that joins users' and fixing all ambiguous columns. The diff only fixes 2 queries that were directly causing the staging outage. While spot checks suggest other code paths are already properly qualified, the systematic audit called for in the spec was not performed or documented. At minimum, the PR should list which files were audited and their compliance status.

The test `test_proposer_cannot_approve_own_loan_product` documents that loan products can currently be approved by their proposers, while policies cannot. The policy self-approval test asserts a Conflict error; the loan product test does not. This asymmetry leaves an unguarded pathway in production.
